items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: we had done a couple of tours together

ctx.x: Oh. Woody, how about talking about when you first got interested in the soprano saxophone?

Well, to the best of my recollections, it would have to do with when Coltrane was in New York and I decided I would listen to what He was doing -- because I had heard some of his recordings, and I was aware of what he was into, and I also knew something about his background and we had done a couple of tours together.
